name: OpenTelemetry Specification 1.60.0: Logs Data Model
statement: The OpenTelemetry log record: Timestamp, ObservedTimestamp, TraceId, SpanId, TraceFlags, SeverityText, SeverityNumber (1-24 in six ranges TRACE to FATAL), Body, Resource, InstrumentationScope, Attributes and EventName. Index row W04; the edition verdant-engine 2.22.4 pins. Cited by REQ-OBSERVABILITY.
